description: Most popular public tweets from a Twitter/X profile (~100 cap) — not chronological. Text, author, engagement, hashtags, media. Flat 2 credits. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

limit.description: Max tweets to return (default 20, max 200). Twitter's public surface usually caps around ~100 most popular posts — not chronological latest. Flat 2 credits per call.

url.description: Twitter/X profile URL or @handle. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: twitter_user_tweets
title: Twitter/X User Tweets
